name: Guanxing Wen
biography: Guanxing Wen is a security researcher with over a decade of experience exploiting bootloaders, TEEs, kernels, and IoT systems. He is a top winner of Huawei bug bounty (2021/2022) and is listed in the Ledger Hall of Fame. His research has been presented at Black Hat, MOSEC, INFILTRATE, Summercon, and QPSS. He currently works at CertiK, where he focuses on low-level systems exploitation and blockchain infrastructure.
